title: androrchis spitzelii subsp. cazorlensis
intro: Androrchis spitzelii subsp. cazorlensis, commonly known as the Spanish orchid, is a rare and endangered species of orchid native to the Iberian Peninsula. It is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. The Spanish orchid is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects.
